title: OHLCV Illiquidity-Proxy Risk Forecasting

protocol.primary_proxy: mean(abs(log return) / (close * base volume)) over 24 candles
protocol.secondary_proxy: mean(log(high / low) / (close * base volume)) over 24 candles
protocol.outcome: log future realized volatility over the next 24 candles
protocol.scope: risk forecasting association, not direction, liquidity causality, execution cost, or trading

mechanics.multiple_testing: Holm, separate P1, P2 diagnostic, and per-pair families

bootstrap.resampling_unit: complete UTC days within each pair/block evaluation half
bootstrap.aggregation: equal weight across informative pair/block units

concentration.method: positive event-level MSE reduction, normalized by evaluation events per unit

decision.decision: OHLCV ILLIQUIDITY-PROXY HYPOTHESIS REJECTED IN PRIMARY SCOPE
decision.reason: At least one central economic, placebo, multiplicity, or replication gate failed on valid data.
decision.scope: incremental risk prediction by an OHLCV proxy; not liquidity causality or trading profitability

limitations: close multiplied by base volume is only approximate quote volume
OHLCV cannot identify spread, depth, aggressor side, or causal price impact
P2 is diagnostic and cannot rescue P1
